# Bash Party Goods (bashnetwork.com)

> Paper party decorations, garlands and table kits. A small group of paper makers in Dayton, Ohio, USA, selling paper fan and honeycomb garlands, cotton fabric bunting, tissue tassel strings, paper confetti and table kits for 8 or 16 guests. Ships flat across the United States and to Canada.

## Pages
- /paper-garlands.html: fan and honeycomb garlands, tassels, confetti, with prices
- /fabric-bunting.html: washable cotton bunting, lengths, prices
- /table-kits.html: what is inside the 8- and 16-guest kits
- /order-decorations.html: order form with a running total
- /who-makes-bash.html: who runs the shop and how an order runs
- /shipping.html and /party-returns.html: delivery and refunds

Contact: party@bashnetwork.com. Decorations only: no event planning, balloon delivery, venue set-up or custom printing.
